dialogues.speaker: Komina
dialogues.text: Hey there, you two! How was it?

choices.text: It was fantastic. I think everyone's really going to like it.

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: Such high praise! I'm sure Mr. Kweku would really appreciate hearing it.

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: He often stares into space, ever since that battle ended. Every time he comes back around, he pushes us to come up with more and more creative and fun ways to work together with saurians.

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: I'm guessing that once upon a time, he must've had a really good friend — one who's still on his mind...

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: The good thing is, he's been doing less of that these days... Working with someone as full of beans as Yehyeh every day sure beats sitting around at home alone.

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: These little saurians do seem to really charm folks.

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: Sure, they don't talk, and they're always getting into trouble, but as long as I have them around, it just feels like everything's going to be okay...

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: Maybe this is exactly what Mr. Kweku hopes everyone can experience for themselves.

choices.text: Saurians really do make great companions.

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: Spending time with saurians feels amazing. I sometimes think it's more effective than some of my treatments.

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: Anyway, enough with the small talk. It's time for me to give the saurians their check-up. If you want to try out those stages, please feel free to do so.

choices.text: Now I really want another go!

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: Alright then... Oh, just a heads-up — people tend to lose track of time when they're playing with saurians.

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: When your body starts to feel tired, that's your cue to take a break.
